subject: Budget request: 3-year commit with ramp scenarios and pro forma
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FY27 planning — budgetary quote request (multi-year scenarios)

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting FY27 budget planning and I need a high-level budgetary quote / pro forma to circulate to finance and procurement. Beacon expects adoption of Redwood across two product teams — conservative consumption estimates attached below.

What we need from you for our budget decks by next Wednesday:
- A 1-year annual upfront (prepay) option with pricing and any applicable discounted tiers.
- A 3-year committed option with suggested ramp schedules (we’re thinking lower first-year adoption and growth years 2–3). Please show the effective term discount compared to list pricing and annualized cost.
- Clarify invoicing options (annual vs upfront), whether credits expire, and any cancellation/true-up terms.
- A pro forma invoice or mock invoice that finance can use.

Estimated annual consumption (for budgetary purposes only):
- Yearly token-equivalent: Year1 = 120M, Year2 = 160M, Year3 = 180M
- Mix: ~80% hosted API usage, 20% Dedicated for PII-sensitive pipelines

We do not need a legally binding quote — this is for internal budget approval. If it helps, list a few common ramp profiles (40/30/30, 30/35/35, and a smoothing option) and the resulting spend. Can you also include any customary term discounts for multi-year commitments?

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director, Cloud Strategy — Beacon Health
attachments: BEACON_usage_estimates.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FY27 planning — budgetary quote request (multi-year scenarios)

Hi Emily — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask. I pulled together three clean option sets for Beacon that finance should be able to drop into FY27 decks. Attaching a pro forma and a short pricing summary for your procurement team.

Quick summary (high level):
Option A — 1-year annual upfront (Annual Prepay)
- List price equivalent: $0.050 / 1k tokens (list used for comparison)
- Volume tiers: 100–199M: 10% off list; 200–299M: 15% off list
- Annual invoice (one payment), credits valid 12 months from invoice date
- Sample for Year1 (120M): effective rate ~ $0.045 / 1k tokens after tier

Option B — 3-year committed (standard ramp 40/30/30)
- Base multi-year commitment discount: 15% off list, additional 3% for 3-year term (applied to committed portion)
- Suggested committed split (example): Year1 40%, Year2 30%, Year3 30% of total committed spend
- Credits applied annually; unused credits can be rolled forward within the 3-year term (non-expiring inside term)
- Annualized effective discount vs list: ~18% depending on ramp

Option C — 3-year smoothing (30/35/35) — front-loaded adoption support
- Similar base discount (15%) + ramp accommodation credit of 2% in Year1 if annual invoicing chosen
- Effective blended discount ~17% with your proposed smoothing split

Other notes:
- Dedicated instances for PII pipelines: separate line-item; volume commitments reduce per-token rates on hosted API portion only.
- Cancellation/true-up: standard 90-day notice for capacity changes; unconsumed committed credits can be applied to future year within term or converted to reserved capacity at prorated rate.

Attachments: Redwood_Beacon_FY27_Proforma_v1.pdf, Redwood_Term_and_Pricing_Summary.pdf

If you prefer, I can model your exact 120/160/180 numbers across the three scenarios and return a clean pro forma (with totals per year and per-token effective rates). Which ramp profile do you prefer us to run for the detailed pro forma?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FY27 planning — budgetary quote request (multi-year scenarios)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick turn. Could you please run the detailed pro forma using our expected consumption (120/160/180) for two scenarios:
1) 40/30/30 (conservative ramp)
2) 30/35/35 (smoothing option)

A few clarifications we need from Redwood:
- Beacon would prefer annual invoicing (one invoice per year) rather than a single upfront payment if possible. Is there any commercial benefit we’d lose by choosing annual invoices instead of one-time upfront?
- For the smoothing option, could Year1 be capped at a lower cash outlay (we’d target paying for 30% in Year1) — what would the effective discount/credit look like if we front-load less?

Procurement asked that the final pro forma include a mock invoice line with GL codes and our PO reference placeholder so finance can route it quickly.

Thanks — our budget deadline is next Wed (7/7).
Emily

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FY27 planning — budgetary quote request (Beacon) — discount ask for smoothing option

Monica / Marissa — forwarding Beacon’s ask. They prefer annual invoices and would like Year1 at 30% of the commit (smoothing). If we give them that, the blended effective discount drops slightly. They’ve asked for GL/PO placeholders in the mock invoice.

Can we approve an additional one-time ramp accommodation credit to bridge Year1 budget constraints? My suggested commercial:
- Offer the 3-year smoothing split (30/35/35) with our standard 15% multi-year discount, plus a 2.5% one-time ramp accommodation credit applied to Year1 invoice only if they choose annual invoicing.
- Document: updated pro forma (attached) with GL codes and a mock invoice line.

Proposed financial impact (approx):
- Committed nominal spend over 3 years (list-equivalent): $1,800,000
- After 15% multi-year discount + 2.5% Year1 credit: effective blended discount ~16.5% across the term (depends on usage)

If approved, I’ll send the updated pro forma to Beacon and include DocuSign SOW options.

Thanks,
Soojin
